description.value: A whole-brain voxel-based morphometry study comparing grey matter volume between abstinent cocaine-dependent and healthy control subjects, including sex-specific analyses.

spans.text: This study examined sex-related differences in grey matter volume between cocaine-dependent and healthy control subjects using voxel-based morphometry.

value: we predicted lower regional brain volumes, specifically in the frontal brain regions, in abstinent CD subjects relative to controls.

we expected different patterns of lower regional brain volume in the CD men and women, specifically in the prefrontal and anterior cingulate regions, as well as in limbic-striatal regions, such as the insula, hippocampus, amygdala and posterior cingulate.
We also expected that years of cocaine abuse would be associated with decreases in brain volume.
